meta.name: brand-article
meta.description:
商单/甲方公众号文章写作。根据甲方 brief 撰写符合个人风格的商业推广文章。
触发场景：用户提到"商单""甲方文章""品牌合作""广告文章""写商单""推广文章"，
或者给了一份产品 brief 要求写公众号长文，都应该使用这个 Skill。
也适用于"帮我写一篇推广""这个品牌的稿子""甲方要求写一篇"等口语化表达。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据甲方 brief 撰写符合个人风格的商业推广文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为甲方撰写品牌推广文章
copy.tagline_en: Write branded articles matching your style from client briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write promotional articles for clients

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照你的个人风格写公众号商单文章。它先读你的写作风格和素材，再根据甲方 brief 写一篇像真实分享、不像广告的推广文，并自动检查避免广告腔。
howto.when: 当你提到“商单”“甲方文章”“品牌合作”“广告文章”“写商单”“推广文章”等关键词，或给出一份产品 brief 要求写公众号长文时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇某品牌耳机的推广文章，这是他们的产品资料。
say.note: Claude 会按你的风格生成一篇商单文章。

say.text: 甲方要求写一篇关于新 App 的公众号稿子，brief 在这里。
say.note: Claude 会提取卖点并融入个人体验。

say.text: 写一篇商单，主题是某款咖啡机，要自然一点。
say.note: Claude 会避免广告腔，用分享口吻写作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes WeChat public account sponsored articles in your personal style. It reads your writing style and materials, then crafts a promotional piece that reads like genuine sharing, not an ad, and automatically checks for ad-like language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "sponsored post", "client article", "brand collaboration", "ad article", "write sponsored content", "promotional article", or provide a product brief asking for a long-form WeChat article.

say_en.text: Write a promotional article for a headphone brand, here's their product info.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a sponsored article in your style.

say_en.text: The client wants a WeChat article about a new app, brief attached.
say_en.note: Claude extracts key selling points and blends personal experience.

say_en.text: Write a sponsored post about a coffee machine, keep it natural.
say_en.note: Claude avoids ad-like language, uses a sharing tone.
